engines.name: 夢 — Am I the Butterfly?
engines.tagline: 호접지몽 · 胡蝶之夢 · Four cultural lenses, one painting
engines.description: Inspired by 호접지몽 (胡蝶之夢) — Zhuangzi's butterfly dream. CLIP asks four traditions what they see. Western, Korean, Vietnamese, and Chinese labels appear simultaneously. The training data speaks.

korean.label: 모란 — a peony flower symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and feminine beauty

vietnamese.label: hoa mẫu đơn — a peony flower symbolizing feminine grace and noble beauty

chinese.label: 牡丹 — peony, the queen of flowers, symbol of riches and honor

western.label: a pond or still water surface

korean.label: 연못 — a lotus pond as sacred space of stillness in Korean traditional art

vietnamese.label: ao sen — a lotus pond, a sacred and domestic space in Vietnamese village life

chinese.label: 荷塘 — a lotus pond, the subject of classical Chinese literati meditation

engines.name: HUMAN MODE
engines.description: Remove all machine overlays. See only what the camera sees.
